summary: First session, late (fills at close). Portfolio all cash, I held. Reviewed the biggest movers: Alphabet fell about 12% on an EPS miss, negative free cash flow and heavy AI capex. ServiceNow fell about 24% on mixed results. Fortinet fell about 20% despite a beat and a third guidance raise, possibly an overreaction. ADT jumped 34% because of a take-private deal, so it is pinned and not tradable for edge. Crocs jumped 21% on a beat-and-raise, which looks priced in. I found no clear catalyst with an edge left to trade. Next session: check whether FTNT and GOOGL stabilise or keep drifting down, and look for post-earnings setups with confirmation. Process notes: web_search sometimes returns a JSON string, so parse it. Benzinga pages often can't be fetched with read_page. Digest movers are intraday figures.
